summary: Renders a GLSL shader into a TOP image. Can run vertex/pixel shaders or compute shaders, expose atomic counters, specialization constants, POP buffers, multiple color buffers, and 2D/2D-array/3D output textures, and should be paired with Info DAT or error checks for compile state.

key_params.name: glslversion
key_params.note: GLSL language version; compute shaders need GLSL 4.30 or later, with 4.60 the current main target

key_params.name: mode
key_params.note: Choose Vertex/Pixel Shader or Compute Shader

key_params.name: predat
key_params.note: Preprocess directives DAT for directives that must appear before TD-inserted declarations

key_params.name: vertexdat
key_params.note: DAT containing optional vertex shader source

key_params.name: pixeldat
key_params.note: DAT containing the pixel shader source

key_params.name: computedat
key_params.note: Compute shader source when using compute mode

key_params.name: compilebehavior
key_params.note: Stall or threaded compile behavior while shaders compile

key_params.name: errorbehavior
key_params.note: Visual output behavior when shader compilation fails

key_params.name: dispatchsizex
key_params.note: Compute dispatch size X

key_params.name: dispatchsizey
key_params.note: Compute dispatch size Y

key_params.name: dispatchsizez
key_params.note: Compute dispatch size Z for 3D/array or custom compute workloads

key_params.name: outputaccess
key_params.note: Write Only or Read-Write access for output textures used by compute shaders

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: Output texture type: 2D Texture, 2D Texture Array, or 3D Texture

key_params.name: customdepth
key_params.note: Manual depth for 3D Texture or 2D Texture Array outputs when not inherited from input

key_params.name: autodispatchsize
key_params.note: Automatically sets compute dispatch from local size and output resolution so at least one thread per pixel runs

key_params.name: clearoutputs
key_params.note: Clear compute outputs at the start of cook or preserve previous cook data

key_params.name: inputmapping
key_params.note: Map inputs to every 3D/array slice or use N inputs per slice

key_params.name: nval
key_params.note: Number of inputs per slice when Input Mapping uses N Input(s) per Slice

key_params.name: numcolorbufs
key_params.note: Number of RGBA color buffers allocated for multi-output shaders

key_params.name: ac0name
key_params.note: Atomic counter uniform name on the Atomic Counters page

key_params.name: const0name
key_params.note: Specialization constant name on the Constants page

key_params.name: buffer0pop
key_params.note: POP whose attribute buffer should be exposed to the shader

key_params.name: buffer0attrclass
key_params.note: Point, Vertex, or Primitive attribute class for a POP buffer

key_params.name: buffer0attr
key_params.note: POP attribute name to expose as a shader buffer

key_params.name: buffer0name
key_params.note: Shader-side name used by the generated TDBuffer_* accessor

key_params.name: outputresolution
key_params.note: Output resolution behavior

key_params.name: resolutionw
key_params.note: Output width when not inherited

key_params.name: resolutionh
key_params.note: Output height when not inherited

common_gotchas: Shader compile failures can produce black output or checkerboard output; inspect compile errors with an Info DAT before declaring success.
Sampler names, output helpers, and uniforms must match TouchDesigner's GLSL conventions for TOP inputs and outputs.
Compute shader mode requires GLSL 4.30 or later; prefer current GLSL 4.60 templates unless compatibility forces otherwise.
When a compute shader reads output textures such as previous frame values, set Output Access to Read-Write instead of Write Only.
Auto Dispatch Size ensures at least one thread per pixel runs, but custom dispatch still needs explicit bounds guards around gl_GlobalInvocationID.
Use Render Select TOP to inspect color buffers beyond buffer 0 when # of Color Buffers is greater than one.
Use the Buffers page for POP attribute access rather than hand-declaring SSBOs; TouchDesigner generates TDBuffer_* helpers.
